meta.title: Chain Track A shortcuts in one planning sentence
meta.summary: SAMPLE $1/hr and $40/mo: ×720 then ÷ price → ~18 users per server.

success.message:
Session complete. Track B sentence, Track A links: ×720, ÷ price, then ÷ per-box, then percent chunks. Say the unit at every link.

SAMPLE: ~18 users/server; 3,000 ÷ 25 = 120 users → 4 boxes; 10k × 5% = 500 customers.

start.message:
SAMPLE planning sentence: GPU $1/hr, product $40/mo. Users per box?

First link?

choices.label: Ignore the hourly and just guess from $40

wrong_start_price_only.message:
Stacked founder math is a chain. Convert time first.

Return to the chain.

wrong_start_times_40.message:
You multiplied unlike units. Cost and price must share a time base.

Return to the chain.

choices.label: 18 — and that is profit per box

wrong_users_gross.message:
At 18 users the box only pays for itself: 18 × $40 = $720 = its cost. Profit starts at user 19.

Revisit the divide.

cover.message: SAMPLE: $3,000/mo of fixed costs, $25 a user, 30 users fit on a box. Users to break even, then boxes?

wrong_cover_skip.message:
Cost ÷ price comes first (users). Then users ÷ per-box limit: 120 → 4 boxes.

Revisit the chain.

wrong_cover_stop.message:
120 is the user count. Each box holds 30: 4 boxes.

Revisit the chain.

funnel.message: Second SAMPLE chain: 10k visitors, 5% conversion. Customers?

wrong_funnel_50.message:
5% is five times 1%. 100×5=500.

Try the funnel again.

wrong_funnel_10000.message:
Visitors are not customers until the percent lands.

Try the funnel again.
